The VC-6 journey "Pi generates a source diff improving redundant task, validates it, executes reproducible comparison and cites native results" has no artifact between "generate a diff" and "validate".

Deliver ONE new pure module and ONE new test file; register nothing; edit no existing file.

src/workbench/patch-proposal.ts (new; imports only: type WorkflowSource, type WorkflowValidation, validateWorkflowSource from ./designer.js; type DefinitionRef, type InvocationSnapshot, canonicalJson, identityDigest from ./identity.js; type CapabilityRegistry from ./capability-registry.js; redactWorkbenchText from ./redaction.js; safeWorkflowTerminalText from ../ui/workflow-card.js; createHash from node:crypto. Nothing from node:fs, node:child_process or any provider):
• PATCH_PROPOSAL_CONTRACT = "workbench.patch-proposal/v1"; class PatchProposalError extends Error { code: "SOURCE_DIGEST_MISMATCH" | "CANDIDATE_TOO_LARGE" | "PROMOTION_PRECONDITION" | "VALIDATION" }.
• proposeWorkflowPatch(input: { base: WorkflowSource; candidateSource: string; rationale: string; hypothesis?: { metric: string; direction: "lower" | "higher"; groundedIn: readonly string[] }; pinnedInvocations?: readonly InvocationSnapshot[]; registry?: CapabilityRegistry; grants?: readonly string[]; limits?: { maxDiffLines?: number; maxPreviewBytes?: number } }): WorkflowPatchProposal.
  – First check: base.definition.artifactDigest must equal `sha256:<hex>` of base.source (same form designer.ts uses) else throw PatchProposalError("SOURCE_DIGEST_MISMATCH") before any diff or validation work.
  – candidate.definition = { ...base.definition, artifactDigest: sha256(candidateSource) }; validation = validateWorkflowSource({ definition: candidate.definition, sourceRef: base.sourceRef, source: candidateSource }, { registry, grants }) so SOURCE_TOO_LARGE, control-character, META and possible-call/grant diagnostics are inherited unchanged and `executed` stays false.
  – diff: deterministic line diff (LCS or Myers) over base vs candidate; hunks `{ op: "context" | "add" | "remove"; baseLine?: number; candidateLine?: number; text: string }` with text = safeWorkflowTerminalText(redactWorkbenchText(line)); bounded by limits.maxDiffLines (default 400) and limits.maxPreviewBytes (default 65536) with `truncated: boolean`; `summary: { added, removed, unchanged }` counted over the FULL diff even when the preview is truncated; identical bytes -> status "no-change" with zero hunks.
  – affectedPinnedInvocations: for each pinnedInvocations entry whose scriptDigest === base.definition.artifactDigest -> { logicalInvocationId, scriptDigest, action: "unchanged", note: "remains pinned to the base digest; the candidate requires a new logical invocation" }; other snapshots are only counted in unrelatedInvocations; input snapshots are never mutated.
  – promotion: { state: "proposed"; requires: "operator"; applied: false }; experiment: { independentVariable: "source"; referenceDigest; candidateDigest; mustHold: ["inputDigest", "modelDigest", "toolsDigest", "environmentDigest", "cacheDigest"] } (the CompareRun field names, so compareWorkflowRuns can later treat source as the only intended difference); hypothesis echoed with grounding: "ungrounded" when groundedIn is empty; causalClaim: false; status: validation.status ("valid" | "invalid" | "uncertain") or "no-change"; contractVersion; proposalDigest = identityDigest("patch-proposal", <proposal without proposalDigest>).
  – Every returned object is deep-frozen plain data; JSON round-trip is lossless.
• recordPromotionDecision(proposal, decision: { decision: "promoted" | "rejected" | "deferred"; principal: { id: string; role?: string }; at: string; reason: string }): PromotionReceipt — frozen; "promoted" requires proposal.status === "valid" else throw PatchProposalError("PROMOTION_PRECONDITION"); receipt fields: contractVersion, proposalDigest, decision, principal, at, reason, appliesTo: "versioned-source", appliedByWorkbench: false, pinnedInvocationsChanged: 0. The module exports no function that accepts a filesystem path.

title: W21-A: deterministic nested-group 10k swarm fixture + bounded grouped projection/inspector benchmark receipt (no cap raise)
description:
Build the measurement harness W21 needs BEFORE any node-cap or aggregation decision. The projection (src/workbench/observation.ts store()) FIFO-evicts the oldest node once maxNodes (default 2000) is reached, so a 10k-operation swarm is silently truncated today; this bead measures that honestly rather than hiding it or raising caps.

Deliver three artifacts, nothing else:
1. test/helpers/swarm-fixture.ts — a deterministic (seeded, no Date.now()/Math.random() in the measured path) generator that yields: >=10,000 `sdk-operation` nodes under 5-level nested `group` nodes joined by `grouping` relations; partial `dependency` and `hypothesis` links (not every node linked); long Unicode titles (CJK, combining marks); large payloadRef strings; and a tick stream of 1-100 active status changes per tick totalling >=100,000 ObservationEvents, all under one invocationId and one ObservationScope. Mixed providers (forge/furnace/claude-agent-sdk) with colliding numeric ids to exercise provider-qualified keys.
2. qa/workbench/grouped-bench.mjs (dist/ imports, same shape as qa/workbench/inspector-bench.mjs) plus a `[build.commands.grouped-bench]` entry in forge.toml: ingest the fixture into `new ObservationProjection()` with DEFAULT limits (maxNodes 2000, maxEdges 4000 — do not raise), then take 1000 keyboard navigation + layoutInspector samples cycling overview/graph/timeline/details at 80x24, 120x40 and ASCII tier, plus resize samples (80x24 <-> 120x40), and write a JSON receipt (W21_BENCH_RECEIPT env path, like W15_BENCH_RECEIPT).
3. test/workbench-grouped-bench.test.ts — vitest guard: two generations of the fixture are deep-equal; group depth is exactly 5; operations >= 10,000; events >= 100,000; ticks have 1..100 changes; the receipt shape has every field named in the acceptance; and a falsifier that fails if the bench projection is constructed with maxNodes > 2000 or maxEdges > 4000.

Out of scope (separate follow-up beads): raising caps, adding ancestor/supernode aggregation to observation.ts or workflow-inspector.ts, dialog wiring, any hot file. Do not modify qa/workbench/inspector-bench.mjs or test/workbench-observation-perf.test.ts.
acceptance_criteria:
All criteria quote docs/workbench specs in the rig (branch workbench/implementation-program).
1. docs/workbench/10-terminal-inspector.md § "Scalability targets (proposed, not measured)": "10k+ grouped operations P2. Record wall time, p50/p95 UI compute, max allocation, file IO and resize metrics; don't declare targets met without measured runs." -> receipt fields present and numeric: totalOperations, totalGroups, groupDepth, retainedNodes, evictedNodes, retainedEdges, evictedEdges, ingestMs, eventsPerSecond, p50/p95/max ingestSampleMs, p50/p95/max navigationMs, p50/p95/max resizeMs, maxRenderedRows, maxTerminalBytes, maxChangedBytes, heapGrowthBytes, plus utc, revision, node, arch, platform, cpus, command.
2. docs/workbench/14-qa-and-benchmarks.md § "Performance benchmark": "Construct deterministic fixture with >=1000 nodes, >=100000 events, 1-100 active changes per tick, 5 nested groups depth, partial graph links, long Unicode paths and large transcript payload refs." -> one vitest assertion per clause; fixture generation twice yields deep-equal output.
3. docs/workbench/14-qa-and-benchmarks.md § "Performance benchmark": "No invented pass numbers." and § "Truth labels and release gates": "Every test evidence artifact includes revision, tool versions, commands, timestamp, host, native references and actual output." -> the bench prints only measured values; it sets a nonzero exit only on measured p95 navigation > 20 ms (mirroring inspector-bench) and asserts no other target.
4. wb-9x5 (W21) notes: "Do not raise caps blindly without bounded sharding/aggregation benchmark." -> falsifier: guard test fails if the bench constructs the projection with maxNodes > 2000 or maxEdges > 4000; receipt must satisfy retainedNodes <= 2000 and evictedNodes === (totalOperations + totalGroups) - retainedNodes, labelled `eviction: "fifo (observation.ts store)"`.
5. docs/workbench/09-observation-and-provenance.md § "Aggregates and profiling": "Distinguish measured actual from estimated projected metrics." -> receipt carries `measured: true` and `aggregation: "none; follow-up bead"`; no estimated or extrapolated number appears.

description: Detached workbench service with authenticated transport, Pi exit/reconnect; Furnace-hosted entrypoint uses native ExecutorApp semantics; no false crash-durability claims. Acceptance: Pi exit/reconnect, semantic safety. Spec: docs/workbench/03, docs/workbench/08, docs/workbench/17.

description:
Gap (groomed by flywheel seat g1 round 3, run g2-work-r3; measured at rig origin/workbench/implementation-program 8147894 = BOUNDARY base at groom time; test anchors from git grep at that tip). SIBLING of wb-6ze.40 (seat g2 round 2, already claimed): that census binds docs/20 'Producer mapping' and 'Refusal and freshness rules'; it was claimed before this remaining half was visible and a claimed bead is never widened, so the two remaining docs/20 sections get their own atomic census.

docs/workbench/20-evidence-loader-contract.md section "UI integration" states seven inspector-side clauses: "the inspector details view renders per-ref state from a synchronous store.get"; "Enter on a selected ref emits a load-evidence action the dialog wires to store.request"; "e inside details advances the evidence selection"; "j/k reset it"; "not-requested renders as 'not loaded (Enter)', never optimistic loading"; "Dialog close calls abortAll and never cancels the workflow"; "With no store supplied the details view renders byte-identical to today". Section "Owner rulings on the design conflicts" lists ten numbered rulings (1 loaded equals the full EvidenceContent; 2 double redaction deliberate and idempotent; 3 loaders take the full request, provider-first routing; 4 producer-qualified cache keys; 5 forge-operation:<operation_id> refs emitted from native-evidence shaping; 6 claude:transcript grant on both transcript paths; 7 e/enter reducer deltas accepted; 8 zero-width stripped in the loader's preview pass; 9 store-level budgets with per-request overrides; 10 inert not-loaded hint until the parent wires load-evidence). Cases embodying every clause and nine rulings exist at the tip (the wb-6ze.17 wiring landed, so ruling 10 is historical), yet NOTHING binds them: git grep over test/ for 'UI integration|Owner rulings' returns nothing; wb-6ze.40 pins neither section; wb-6ze.38/39 bind docs/10. A rename, deletion or .skip of the inspector A-series or the wiring cases leaves the docs/20 UI contract claim intact with nothing red. docs/14 "Truth labels and release gates": "Each major work package must have a falsifier".

Candidate pins measured at 8147894 (EVIDENCE; the worker VERIFIES every title at the claim-time base; inspector titles use single quotes and no space after it(). UI clause 1 synchronous store.get -> test/workbench-inspector.test.ts:843 'A8 layoutInspector is synchronous and never awaits a pending loader'. Clause 2 Enter -> load-evidence -> store.request -> :719 'A1 a full keyboard journey and render loads nothing; exactly one call follows Enter on the selected ref; e only moves the selection' and test/workbench-evidence-wiring.test.ts:204 'wires Enter in the details view to store.request for the focused reference'. Clause 3 e advances -> :719 (A1) and :753 'A3 e outside the details view still opens it; a node without references has no load action'. Clause 4 j/k reset -> :745 'A2 j/k reset the evidence selection'. Clause 5 'not loaded (Enter)' never optimistic -> :719 (A1 asserts the literal at :725) and :896 'A12 the dialog does not treat load-evidence as close or cancel'; the census additionally asserts the literal "not loaded (Enter)" occurs in test/workbench-inspector.test.ts at HEAD (literal pin, same scanner). Clause 6 close -> abortAll, never cancels -> test/workbench-evidence-wiring.test.ts:213 'wires dialog close to abortAll and never to workflow cancellation' and test/workbench-inspector.test.ts:824 'A7 Esc and ctrl+c while loading only close; abort stops the local read and nothing touches the projection'. Clause 7 byte-identical without a store -> :852 'A9 without a store the details view is the pre-existing rendering and Enter still folds'. Rulings (file test/workbench-evidence-loader.test.ts unless named): 1 -> :231 'keeps only digest-shaped sourceBasis, a bounded sanitized receipt, and honors stale freshness'; 2 -> :209 'redacts secrets before display, including one that would straddle a chunk boundary' plus test/workbench-redaction.test.ts idempotence title the worker verifies (wb-3l3 in flight owns a JSON-embedded non-idempotence defect: if no idempotence title exists, record ruling 2 partial naming wb-3l3); 3 -> :61 'routes by nativeRef.provider first, then canLoad; anything else is a visible no-loader'; 4 -> :71 'keys entries producer-qualified so same-scope cross-producer ref strings cannot collide'; 5 -> test/workbench-native-details.test.ts:98 'lists a forge-operation evidence ref in the node details pane' and the forge-observer/native-evidence shaping title that emits forge-operation:<id> (worker verifies; else partial); 6 -> test/workbench-inspector.test.ts:873 'A11 claude evidence is refused unauthorized without the claude:transcript grant, rendered byte-identical to a revoked grant, and loaded with it' and :318 'claude: without the claude:transcript grant nothing is read and the ref refuses unauthorized, the same entry a revoked grant leaves'; 7 -> :745 (A2) and :753 (A3); 8 -> :220 'strips terminal escapes, bidi and zero-width characters from preview lines'; 9 -> :189 'a per-request override can only lower the store budget'; 10 -> status 'superseded' with reason 'wb-6ze.17 landed the load-evidence wiring; the inert hint was the pre-wiring state', never pinned, never passed.

Scope (atomic, test-only, src and docs untouched): ONE new vitest file test/workbench-evidence-ui-census.test.ts holding a frozen table of seventeen rows {clause (docs/20 text verbatim), section ('UI integration' | 'Owner rulings'), tier 'default-gate', pins: [{file, title}] or literal pins [{file, literal}], status: 'pinned' | 'partial' | 'superseded', reason?}. For every pin it reads the file at HEAD (node:fs, repo-relative, no globbing library; copy the census scanner shape of wb-0kg.11 locally, never import another test file; handle the inspector file's it('...') form with no space) and asserts the exact occurrence exists exactly once and is not it.skip / it.todo / it.fails / it.only; it asserts each clause and each numbered ruling is present verbatim in docs/workbench/20-evidence-loader-contract.md at HEAD (docs drift guard; wb-1vd, in flight, rewrites only the 'Types' paragraph, which this census does not pin); it never executes the pinned cases, never renders, never claims a live or native pass from a title's presence, and adds no behaviour test for a partial or superseded row. A failure names the clause, file and title. (2) "Seconds-only clock tick <=1Hz and only for visible running rows." (3) "No 80ms whole-dialog refresh under large-workload mode." (4) "Pure layout and keyboard reducers are unit-tested without a TTY." (5) "Avoid O(allHistory) collapse per frame; maintain by-node last projection and ancestor aggregates incrementally." (6) "Virtualized visible rows + modest overscan; expensive Markdown syntax parsing only for selected transcript slice." (7) "Graph layout cached by topology revision; no force-directed re-layout in render method. For large graphs show aggregate supernodes first." (8) "Bound memory: store highlights/current snapshots; stream older event/traces lazily." (9) "Pi observation tools paginate/filter/limit and return compact JSON, never rendered ANSI." docs/workbench/14-qa-and-benchmarks.md "Truth labels and release gates": "Each major work package must have a falsifier: a negative test that would fail if a critical guarantee was quietly weakened." title: wb-g1g.1 review: evidence preview bounding cuts inside UTF-8 sequences and UTF-16 surrogate pairs (boundPreview/safeChunks), fabricating U+FFFD and lone surrogates and exceeding maxBytes by up to 2 bytes
description:
Adversarial review finding (flywheel reviewer, run g1-r3) against machine/flywheel/wb-g1g.1 @ 96b64fa (tree 9cd29f2, gate cmd_a8b4e1ffdff4). Reproduced in a detached review worktree at 96b64fa with vitest 4.1.10; probe files were deleted after the run, nothing tracked was modified.

CONFIRMED: src/workbench/evidence-loader.ts bounds preview text by raw UTF-8 bytes and by UTF-16 code units, never by code points, so the bounded preview can contain characters the evidence never contained and can exceed the per-entry byte budget.

1. boundPreview (evidence-loader.ts, `Buffer.from(part).subarray(0, remaining).toString()`): a byte cut inside a multi-byte UTF-8 sequence decodes to U+FFFD. Probe: loader preview ['漢'.repeat(1000)] with bytes 3000, store maxBytes 100 -> loaded entry whose preview content (excluding the '[truncated]' marker) is 102 bytes and whose last content line ends in U+FFFD ('漢'x33 + '�'). Measured: {"sum":113,"withoutMark":102,"maxBytes":100,"hasFFFD":true}. The bead's AC3 says "at most maxBytes per entry"; the overshoot is bounded (at most 2 bytes: a 1-byte partial replaced by a 3-byte U+FFFD) but it is a measured violation, and the U+FFFD is a glyph not present in the source.

2. safeChunks (evidence-loader.ts, `cleaned.slice(at, at + EVIDENCE_LINE_CHARS)`): slicing at 240 UTF-16 code units splits a surrogate pair when the boundary is odd relative to the pairs. Probe: preview ['a' + '😀'.repeat(130)] (261 code units) -> two chunks of lengths [240, 21]; chunk 0 ends with "\ude00\ud83d" (an unpaired high surrogate) and chunk 1 starts with "\ude00\ud83d" (an unpaired low surrogate). Measured: {"loneSurrogatePerLine":[true,true]}. Neither redactWorkbenchText, stripUnsafeText (UNSAFE_TEXT covers C0/C1 and bidi only), the loader's zero-width strip nor safeWorkflowTerminalText removes lone surrogates, so they survive into the EvidenceEntry and, in the Unicode tier, into the inspector's `add()`/`safe()` output (the ASCII tier masks them as '?'). The existing suites only exercise ASCII payloads at the byte boundary ('x'.repeat(1 MiB)) and even-length emoji-free lines, so neither case is pinned; the 107 existing cases pass.

Why it matters (quoted criteria from the bead): AC3 docs/workbench/09 "store reference/short redacted preview" -> "at most maxBytes per entry (preview bounded)"; AC4 docs/workbench/12-security.md § "Input and output hardening": "Validate Unicode and terminal escape sequences before display" and docs/workbench/10 "visible unknowns, never fabricated". A preview that shows U+FFFD or lone surrogates displays text the source never carried; the bounded view should cut on code-point boundaries and keep the byte budget exact.

Suggested fix (evidence-loader.ts only; no hot or do-not-edit file): in boundPreview, accumulate code points (for..of) while Buffer.byteLength(cp) fits `remaining`, never cut inside a sequence; in safeChunks, chunk with Array.from(cleaned) (code points) so a pair is never split; optionally strip any remaining lone surrogate in the loader's own local pass (ruling 8 already gives that pass the zero-width strip). Red-first pins in test/workbench-evidence-loader.test.ts: (a) '漢'.repeat(1000) at maxBytes 100 -> content bytes <= 100 and no U+FFFD in any line; (b) 'a'+'😀'.repeat(130) -> no lone surrogate in any chunk (regex /[\uD800-\uDBFF](?![\uDC00-\uDFFF])|(?<![\uD800-\uDBFF])[\uDC00-\uDFFF]/ matches no line); plus one inspector case rendering (b) at 120x40 Unicode tier with the same assertion over every output line, visibleWidth <= width.

Relation to the open wb-g1g.1 respin (BOUNDARY 09:59:13Z ruling: unauthorized for a missing grant, branch frozen at 96b64fa until the respin lands fast-forward): this is a distinct, additive P3 defect in the same module; the owner may fold it into that respin or land it as a follow-up after wb-g1g.1 closes. Not a duplicate of wb-952 (sanitizer order / zero-width class), wb-563 (host-clock capturedAt) or the redactWorkbenchText non-idempotence P3; store-wide bead search for fffd / multibyte / subarray / byte budget returned nothing.

title: claude evidence loader stamps capturedAt from the host clock when no now() is injected
description: Machine finding during wb-g1g.1 verification (evidence-producers.ts:84): the claude session loader falls back to Date.now()/new Date() for capturedAt when deps carry no now(). Workbench convention injects now() at every wiring site (reconcile tool, decision cores) so records are testable and resume-stable. Fix: require now in the loader deps (or thread the one index.ts injects) and drop the fallback; pin with a test that a loader built without a clock refuses rather than invents a timestamp.
